note:
lymphosat is (semi?) vibe coded to include a host of different solvers that hyperspecialize on a problem to beat out the best solvers on the SAT Competition 2026 (SC26).

Most solvers got 133-135/191 whereas lymphosat got 146/191, 8% better than the state of the art.

The name is inspired from biology by emulating, at a high level, how our immune system fights disease (finding patterns in disease vectors and specializing).

Code is said to 'be released with the paper' but I can't find it through a shallow search.
